notes: Discovery source01: ELEMENT59.126984/NONE70.476190/LOCKED67.222222%; NONE repaired163/broke20. LOCKED failed its fixed primary; this new candidate never rewrites that gate.
New fixed seed2026092702 independently confirms NONE vs ELEMENT while CLEAN_SIG isolates signature-only t2 noise bypass; one candidate plus two required controls, no new coefficient or scan.

CLEAN_SIG still executes original t2 Dropout(.1) for the main path with exactly the original RNG draws; only SIG_TIME reads its input after original pooling, no detach and no second IQ forward. Upstream dropout remains, so the entire path is not claimed deterministic.

NONE removes a stochastic operation and can change subsequent GPU random realization. CLEAN_SIG keeps the ELEMENT RNG draw schedule, addressing this limitation without dummy optimization or extra noise.

At eval t2.dropout is identity; the same weights give the same deployed joint160 and default head logits. Training gradients differ in the signature route; defaultW/gains/norm remain jointly learned as usual.
Current signature pooling contains first path increments plus antisymmetric second-order terms with time; not the whole infinite signature and not assumed invariant to arbitrary receiver channels.

The fixed CLEAN_SIG primary must beat both controls in errors with CE no higher. Independently, NONE confirmation must beat ELEMENT in errors with CE no higher. All rows require final trainingLCE<=.5; controls never rescue a failed primary.

Source-only actual20-epoch training, not an availability-only gradient probe. After success use separate formal all-five-RX three-seed preregistration; no source-fold weight reuse and no repeated source scans.

Original source carrier L6300/U56700hidden/V27000 checked once, then all training/probe/U/V/calibration loaders exclude RX1 before model/EMA. Effective L5040/U45360hidden/V21600; held original visibleL1260 only eval.

Old discarded144 training anchor reads retained by the unchanged fold helper and disclosed; no forward or loss uses them. U tensor TX remains hidden and metadata stripped. No ordinaryL/satellite augmentation, original U Gaussian kept.

No ownEMA export comparison/tail window averaging in this candidate; own EMA teacher training remains original. No R-Drop/extra loss/head-fitting/parameter addition. Each row full steps/epochs/predictions analyzed after terminal artifacts.

Global path-signature learning is established by Deep Signature Transforms (NeurIPS2019), https://papers.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2019/hash/d2cdf047a6674cef251d56544a3cf029-Abstract.html . This is a CVS noise-placement hypothesis, not a claimed first signature architecture; search alone cannot certify novelty.
